title: Glad they were cheap
text: Glad they were cheap. I'm glad they were cheap because they're useless. They slide on glass shelves and anything you put on them will slide them out of place too. Now I have to find a use for them or just toss them.

product_metadata.title: BAKHUK 18pcs Refrigerator Liners Mats, Refrigerator Shelf Liners Washable, Fridge Liners for Freezer Glass Cupboard Cabinet Drawers Table Mats(4 Blue, 4 Green, 4 Red, 6 Clear)
features: GREAT VALUE PACKAGE: 29x45cm /11x17.7in. Each refrigerator shelf liner weighs about 40g. Each pack contains 4 pink, 4 green, 4 blue, and 6 clear mats, enough quantities and colors can help you quickly sort food in your fridge.
HIGH QUALITY: Each refrigerator liner is made of high-quality EVA materials, without heavy metals and phthalic acid, food-grade material that can be recycled and decomposed.

FEATURES: These washable fridge liners and mats have super low-temperature resistance, a soft feel yet with high ductility, with convex dot pattern, easy to clean, just use a towel to wipe, help you clean fridge without effort. Free to cut.
HOW TO USE: Smooth face down. When using, place a few drops of water on the refrigerator shelf to secure the refrigerator pad.
FUNCTIONS: Waterproof, dustproof, oilproof, easy to clean, also can be used as drawer liners, cabinet liners.
